name: c9r
description: Claude Code and Codex plugins from c9r.

plugins.name: browser-check
plugins.description: Run a plain-English QA checklist in a real browser, with a classifier deciding each step.

plugins.name: browser-check-visual
plugins.description: Judge browser-check's visual steps (layout, colour, clipping, icons) from a screenshot with a vision classifier.

plugins.name: soft-lint
plugins.description: Ask a classifier plain-English yes/no questions about the lines a diff adds, after each edit or over a branch.
